principles: A suggestion must never change command status, mutate the host, or block a valid low-level operation.
Only promoted, implemented, generic capabilities may be suggested for execution.
Project-specific semantics belong in recipes/project knowledge, not capability-routing rules.
A low-level fallback remains valid; callers should record why a promoted capability was not suitable when the reason is known.

preferred_for: discover implemented primitives, argument schemas, promoted recipes, lifecycle state, and supersession metadata before designing a multi-step workflow
check whether a requested semantic already exists before proposing new syntax sugar
supersedes: manual fragmented discovery across adapter.capabilities + recipe.list + knowledge.search
not_for: choosing project-specific semantics on behalf of the caller
entries.suggestion: Before composing a new multi-step workflow or proposing new syntax sugar, query capability.search for the intended semantics.

preferred_for: reconcile declared nodes, parameters, state, and wiring as one verified transaction
create-or-update a small declared network and optionally cook it
supersedes: manual create/update/connect sequences whose desired final graph is already known declaratively
not_for: writes that must remain conditional on hashes from an earlier external read
arbitrary cleanup of nodes not owned by the declaration
entries.suggestion: A promoted declarative transaction may reduce round trips: consider network.ensure_transactional when the desired final node graph is already known.

preferred_for: read multiple known parameters in one request
not_for: reads that depend on a value returned by the immediately preceding read
entries.suggestion: Multiple independent parameter reads were observed; parm.batch_read may reduce round trips.

preferred_for: write multiple independently known parameters after all expected hashes are available
not_for: writes where each next value/hash depends on the previous write result
entries.suggestion: Multiple independent parameter writes were observed; parm.batch_write may reduce round trips while preserving expected-hash preflight.

preferred_for: apply multiple independently known input connections in one preflighted request
not_for: connections whose source/target choice depends on a previous connection result
entries.suggestion: Multiple independent connections were observed; node.batch_connect may reduce round trips.

preferred_for: create a temporary diagnostic network, cook it, collect bounded diagnostics, and guarantee cleanup in one lifecycle
supersedes: temporary node creation + wiring + cook + result collection + cleanup sequences
not_for: unbounded retry or arbitrary code execution

intended_contract.lifecycle: validate -> create isolated temporary namespace -> cook -> collect bounded diagnostics -> cleanup in finally
intended_contract.timeout: must return a durable operation/lifecycle state rather than encourage blind retry
intended_contract.result_collection: generic warnings/errors/messages and bounded attribute/geometry summaries only

promotion_requirements: define bounded schema without project-specific attributes or UV semantics
regression tests for cleanup on success, cook failure, collection failure, and timeout/unknown
live validation on at least two unrelated Houdini workflows
prove it reduces round trips without removing low-level fallback
entries.suggestion: Candidate only; do not route execution here until the capability is implemented and promoted.
